basics.description: Deploy the **Digital Scout** web app to Azure App Service (Linux, Node 22 LTS). The app is served from a prebuilt, self-contained package — no build runs in Azure.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Azure region for the App Service plan and web app.

basics.name: webAppName
basics.label: Web app name
basics.toolTip: Globally unique name. The site is reachable at https://<name>.azurewebsites.net.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-60 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; must start and end with a letter or number.

elements.name: sku
elements.label: App Service plan SKU
elements.toolTip: Compute tier for the App Service plan.

elements.name: packageUrl
elements.label: Package URL
elements.toolTip: Public URL of the prebuilt web app zip published by the release workflow.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid https URL ending in .zip.
